en: A black‑and‑white image of a two‑storey wooden house in a rural setting, likely serving as a small village shop or inn. The building has vertical wooden siding painted dark with light trim, a steep tiled or shingled roof, and a decorative front balcony or porch with ornate woodwork. Several people, including children and adults in early 20th‑century rural clothing, stand in front of the house along a dirt road, with trees and open land surrounding the scene.
